# invisible-string

> An open-source, self-hostable platform for AI agents: build an agent — a persona, a model, and the tools it's equipped with — chat with it directly, or delegate standing work with workflows fired from Slack, forms, webhooks, or a schedule. Every published agent compiles into a self-hosted, version-pinned process; runs stream live, pause for human approval, and survive infrastructure failure without losing work.

## Docs

- [Overview](/docs/getting-started/overview): what invisible-string is and how the pieces fit
- [Quickstart](/docs/getting-started/quickstart): build, publish, chat, delegate
- [Agents](/docs/concepts/agents): persona, model, context — and how publishing versions them
- [Workflows](/docs/concepts/workflows): standing delegations — trigger, agent, instructions
- [Sessions & runs](/docs/concepts/sessions-and-runs): one run per session, resumable streams, how runs end
- [Chat](/docs/building/chat): the run timeline, stopping a run, queued messages, context controls
- [Triggers](/docs/building/triggers): chat, webhook, form, Slack, and schedule ingress
- [Context & MCP](/docs/building/context-mcp): connector catalog, registry search, OAuth, tool filters
- [Models](/docs/building/models): presets, reasoning effort, and how both get pinned at publish
- [Architecture](/docs/platform/architecture): control plane, stateless workers, compiler
- [Durability](/docs/platform/durability): runs survive worker death and resume anywhere
- [Security](/docs/platform/security): credential custody, workspace scoping, guarded egress
